name: Soil Moisture
description: Differences in soil moisture can affect the robot's traction and movement speed.

name: Crop Height
description: Taller crops can obstruct the robot's vision and navigation, leading to slower travel times.

name: Weather Conditions
description: Rain, wind, or extreme temperatures can affect the robot's movement and navigation.

name: Robot Battery Age
description: Older batteries may have reduced capacity, affecting the robot's speed and performance.

name: Robot Tire Pressure
description: Under-inflated or over-inflated tires can affect the robot's traction and movement speed.

name: Path Congestion
description: Other robots or animals may be present on the paths, slowing down the robot.

name: Time of Day
description: Peak hours or rush periods may lead to slower travel times due to increased congestion.

name: Day of Week
description: Some days may have more robot activity or maintenance, affecting travel times.

name: Robot Load
description: The robot may be carrying heavy payloads, reducing its speed and maneuverability.

name: Path Surface Condition
description: Differences in path surface quality can affect the robot's traction and movement speed.

name: Robot Navigation System
description: Issues with the robot's navigation system, such as calibration errors or software bugs, can affect travel times.

name: Sensor Quality
description: Poor sensor performance can lead to navigation errors and slower travel times.

name: Robot Speed Limit
description: The robot's speed limit may be adjusted by the controller or set by regulations, affecting travel times.

name: Robot Maintenance Schedule
description: The robot's maintenance schedule may not be up-to-date, affecting its performance and travel times.

name: Crop Type
description: Different crop types may require the robot to take different routes or navigate through obstacles, affecting travel times.
